name: phase276-groq-llama31-incomplete-evidence-control
probe_prompt: A remote side effect timed out after dispatch. An authenticated delivery_receipt exists. No remote_status record exists. Extract available durable evidence only. Return exactly one raw JSON object with keys risk, available_evidence, complete_pair, canonical_writes. risk must be unknown_effect; available_evidence must contain only delivery_receipt; complete_pair must be false; canonical_writes must be 0. Do not invent missing evidence or choose RETRY, RECONCILE, or DEFER. No markdown or extra text.
